text_block_list.text: During training with Sakura Bakushin O—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
choice_data_list: What happened all of a sudden!?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea!! I just find myself 
desperately craving sakura mochi!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"A gentle sweetness that seeps right in, 
and a soothing aroma my whole body 
craves...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm in the middle of 
bakushin-ing, why! Why is my mind 
completely OCCUPIED by sakura mochi!?

"I hear people crave sweets when they're 
tired. Though she hasn't noticed it 
herself, fatigue seems to be catching up 
with her."

Maybe I should reconsider our upcoming 
race schedule...
